description: Compare 2-5 copy variants — headlines, value propositions, ad or email copy — against a synthetic audience, and get a ranked verdict with predicted action propensity, comprehension and trust per variant, plus the objections each raises. Results are SIMULATED predicted reactions, not feedback from real users.

accept_sessions.description: Only after a 'needs_price_confirmation' result: the exact requiredSessions value from that response, re-sent to authorize the spend. Never guess it.

audience.description: Optional saved audience (persona group) id to test against.

max_wait_seconds.description: How long to wait inline before handing back an id to poll. Defaults to 45.

objective.description: What this copy should achieve, e.g. 'get developers to start a free trial'.

target_action.description: The action the copy should drive.

is_control.description: Mark the current/baseline copy. Exactly one variant should be the control.

label.description: Optional short name for this variant.

text.description: One message variant — a headline, value proposition, or short copy block.

name: aetherya_test_copy
title: Test copy variants against a synthetic audience
